briefdescription.para: The stack allocation containing all EH data, including the link in the fs:00 chain and the current state.
The index of the state field of RegNode.
The linked list node subobject inside of RegNode.
runOnFunction - Virtual method overriden by subclasses to do the per-function processing of the pass.
doInitialization - Virtual method overridden by subclasses to do any necessary initialization before any pass is run.
doFinalization - Virtual method overriden by subclasses to do any necessary clean up after all passes have run.
getAnalysisUsage - This function should be overriden by passes that need analysis information to do their job.

detaileddescription.para: If a pass specifies that it uses a particular analysis result to this function, it can then use the getAnalysis<AnalysisType>() function, below.

briefdescription.para: getPassName - Return a nice clean name for a pass.

detaileddescription.para: This usually implemented in terms of the name that is registered by one of the Registration templates, but can be overloaded directly.

briefdescription.para: Generate a thunk that puts the LSDA of ParentFunc in EAX and then calls PersonalityFn, forwarding the parameters passed to PEXCEPTION_ROUTINE: typedef _EXCEPTION_DISPOSITION (*PEXCEPTION_ROUTINE)( _EXCEPTION_RECORD *, void *, _CONTEXT *, void *); We essentially want this code: movl $lsda, eax jmpl ___CxxFrameHandler3.

Get the common EH registration subobject: typedef _EXCEPTION_DISPOSITION (*PEXCEPTION_ROUTINE)( _EXCEPTION_RECORD *, void *, _CONTEXT *, void *); struct EHRegistrationNode { EHRegistrationNode *Next; PEXCEPTION_ROUTINE Handler; };.

The _except_handler3/4 registration node: struct EH4ExceptionRegistration { void *SavedESP; _EXCEPTION_POINTERS *ExceptionPointers; EHRegistrationNode SubRecord; int32_t EncodedScopeTable; int32_t TryLevel; };.
The __CxxFrameHandler3 registration node: struct CXXExceptionRegistration { void *SavedESP; EHRegistrationNode SubRecord; int32_t TryLevel; };.
